repo:cloud#3 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BvRcDHXqRU4TSVE4u6

Answer: #31414 step 1 (cloud read, for domain:server#1) · 2026-11-08T18:04Z

Read at objectstack-ai/cloud main `ba6f0fa`. These are code readings; nothing was run.

**Short answer:** cloud's agent runtime resolves a tool by **bare name, with no package context**, for both chat and MCP. But it resolves against its in-process `ToolRegistry`, which plugins fill in code. It never reads a metadata `tool` item or `/meta/tool/NAME` to pick what runs.

| Path | Resolution | file#symbol |
|---|---|---|
| Registry | A `Map<string, …>` keyed by `definition.name`. `register` is `set`, so a second register under the same name silently replaces the first (last wins). | `packages/service-ai/src/tools/tool-registry.ts#ToolRegistry.register` |
| Who fills it | Plugins in code, on the `ai:ready` hook. The open runtime registers none; `@objectstack/service-ai-studio` registers the shipped families. | `packages/service-ai/src/plugin.ts` (the `ctx.trigger('ai:ready', …)` block) |
| Chat (`skill.tools`) | Each claimed name is looked up by bare name in a map built from the full registry; a trailing `*` matches by prefix. | `packages/service-ai/src/skill-registry.ts#SkillRegistry.flattenToTools`, called from `packages/service-ai/src/agent-runtime.ts` (`availableTools`) |
| Direct execute | `POST /api/v1/ai/tools/:toolName/execute` does `toolRegistry.has(toolName)` and then `execute`. | `packages/service-ai/src/routes/tool-routes.ts` |
| MCP (cloud's build door) | Its source is the same `aiService.toolRegistry`, so tools/list and tools/call see the same bare-name map. | `packages/service-ai-studio/src/plugin.ts#mcpDoorSource` → `createMcpDoorRegistry` |
| Metadata `tool` items | Written as a **mirror** of what code registered, for Studio visibility (`register('tool', name, …, { notify: false })` when absent). The runtime only probes `exists('tool', '__probe__')` for store reachability. | `packages/service-ai-studio/src/plugin.ts` (the `selectToolDefinitions` loop); `packages/service-ai/src/plugin.ts` (the probe) |

**What this means for step 2.** No cloud consumer reads a tool with package context. No cloud consumer executes from the metadata `tool` item either: a package-declared `tool` metadata item reaches no handler in cloud's AI runtime. In cloud, the `/meta/tool/NAME` shadowing changes what Studio shows, not what an agent calls. The live same-name hazard on the cloud side is the `ToolRegistry`'s silent last-wins `set`. That is cloud's own code, outside this card's fix. Seat 3 can file it as a cloud card if domain:server wants it recorded. The framework's own `/mcp` tools/list and tools/call are objectstack code and are measured on your side.
